lines.text: Via delle Fornaci 7 · Borgo Valdorso (TO) · Production plant
Supplier qualification SQ-2007-002 - Fosfazinco Nord S.p.A., ZP-40
Material: zinc phosphate anti-corrosive pigment ZP-40, for AF-12.
Results: zinc phosphate 98.5 %; free alkalinity not detectable (< 0.05 %); pH of 10 %
slurry 6.9; oil absorption 28 g/100 g; lead < 50 ppm.
Trial batches AF-12 with ZP-40 (T1-T3): storage stability 12 weeks at 40 °C - no livering,
viscosity increase 3-5 %. Trial T3 was prepared without the ammonium chloride addition
and behaved like T1 and T2.
Anti-corrosion: salt spray 500 h equivalent to the CL-77 formulation.
Conclusion: ZP-40 approved for AF-12 from recipe Rev 11/12 (2007).
